title: Minimum cores in lattice graphs: zonotope structure and quartic growth
abstract: arXiv:2611.18633v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A core of a graph is a nonempty vertex set in which every member has at least as many neighbours inside the set as outside. We study the minimum size $c_{m,n}$ of a finite core in the graph on $\Z^m$ joining points at sup-norm distance at most $n$. The local majority condition imposes a global geometric constraint: the convex hull of every core has an explicit lattice zonotope $H_n^{(m)}$ as a Minkowski summand. In the plane, this zonotope has width asymptotic to $6\zeta(3)n^3/\pi^2$. We prove that all its lattice points form a core and construct a shell with $O(n^4)$ points. Together with a packing argument, this gives $c_{2,n}=\Theta(n^4)$ and coordinate widths $\Theta(n^3)$ for every minimum core. We determine $c_{2,1}=12$ and $c_{2,2}=96$ by analytic arguments and prove uniqueness up to translation in both cases. translated_title: 格图中的最小核心：Zonotope（超平行体）结构与四次方增长
translated_abstract: 图的一个“核心”是指一个非空顶点集，其中每个顶点位于集合内部的邻居数量不少于其位于集合外部的邻居数量。我们研究了 $\Z^m$ 上连接 sup-范数距离不超过 $n$ 的点的图中有限核心的最小规模 $c_{m,n}$。这种局部多数条件施加了一个全局几何约束：每个核心的凸包都以一个显式的格点 zonotope $H_n^{(m)}$ 作为 Minkowski 和因子。在平面上，该 zonotope 的宽度渐近于 $6\zeta(3)n^3/\pi^2$。我们证明了该 zonotope 的所有格点构成一个核心，并构造了一个包含 $O(n^4)$ 个点的壳层。结合填装论证，这给出了 $c_{2,n}=\Theta(n^4)$，且每个最小核心的坐标宽度为 $\Theta(n^3)$。我们通过解析论证确定了 $c_{2,1}=12$ 和 $c_{2,2}=96$，并证明了两种情形下在平移意义下的唯一性。显式的强制集与亏量证书进一步确定了规定 zonotope 包络内的更多最小值。
tldr: 本文证明了平面格图中有限核心的最小规模为 Θ(n⁴)，发现每个核心的凸包必含一个宽度渐近于 n³ 的显式格点 zonotope 作为 Minkowski 和因子，并精确确定了 c₂,₁=12、c₂,₂=96 及其平移唯一性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the minimum size of finite cores in planar lattice graphs is Θ(n⁴), showing every core's convex hull contains an explicit lattice zonotope of width ~n³ as a Minkowski summand, and exactly determines c_{2,1}=12 and c_{2,2}=96 with uniqueness up to translation.
